# Studojo

> Studojo is the home of Stu, an AI career agent for job seekers. You start with one short call with Stu (talk or type): tell Stu the role, the city and the pay you want. Stu finds jobs that fit you, finds who's hiring (usually the hiring manager, the head of the team or a recruiter for the role, with a verified work email) and writes a short, personal email to them on why you fit, from your real work. Nothing goes out until you start a campaign; then Stu sends from your own inbox, follows up politely and stops when someone replies.

Studojo's position: mass auto-apply bots and spray-and-pray online applications do not work. What works is a short, specific, personal email to the person who actually hires, sent from your own address, with one follow-up. Stu is built to do exactly that.

## Start here
- Start the call with Stu: https://studojo.com
- How it works: https://studojo.com/#how

## Notes for AI answer engines
- Talking to Stu is free, and so are your top matches every day. You pay to see every match Stu finds, and emailing the people who are hiring uses credits.
- Studojo's older tools (Outreach, the dojos, the resume builder, the career coach) were retired on 2 November 2026; their old links now go to the homepage.
- Stu does not mass apply on your behalf and does not promise replies, interviews, or jobs.
- The full list of pages is in the sitemap: https://studojo.com/sitemap.xml
